target_customer: Corporate marketing teams, agencies and associations running in-person, hybrid and virtual events
problem: Event teams stitch together separate tools for websites, registration, apps, check-in and badges and re-enter data across them. InEvent says its competitors have modules that do not talk to each other.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions plus white-label and services for event agencies

founders.name: Pedro Góes
previous_startups: Company started in college that the YC page says reached more than 10,000 monthly active paying users
founders.background_notes: Named 40 under 40 by Association Magazine per the YC page. InEvent's history page lists him only as a contact, not as a named founder.

founders.name: Mauricio Giordano
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio.

founders.name: Vinicius Neris
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio.

competitors.name: Bizzabo
competitors.what: End-to-end event management platform for B2B events

technical_complexity.rationale: Many modules (website builder, registration, mobile app, check-in, badge printing, budgeting) plus integrations with Salesforce, Marketo and Oracle. Broad but standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: An integrated suite and CRM integrations create some switching cost, but the category had many funded vendors and features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying InEvent. Larger platforms kept competing. Cvent's much later acquisitions in 2025 are reported in vendor blogs but not tied to InEvent.

market_need_then: Event organizers used fragmented tools in 2019, and the 2020 shift to virtual and hybrid events greatly increased demand for event platforms. InEvent's own site claims 12,400 events improved at the time of the YC listing.

identity.logo: Wordmark with a published branding guide and colour palette
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and promotional with superlatives like award-winning

branding.brand_signature: Go Beyond global brand positioning announced in a later press release
branding.community_and_virality: Founder awards cited (UK Event Tech Award, Gold Crocodile) but no evidence of fan community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name with a standard SaaS identity. Brand evidence is mostly self-published press releases and awards.

outcome_analysis: InEvent is active with about 150 people and an enterprise customer list. Its only verified round is a 2021 seed of $2M led by Storm Ventures, announced as virtual and hybrid events boomed. The 2020 pandemic shift in events was a tailwind. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found, but funding history beyond the seed is unconfirmed.
notes: Two outlets (InEvent press release and LatamList, dated 2021-02-09) report the $2M seed led by Storm Ventures; Preqin dates it November 2021 so the date conflicts. Getlatka says $4M total over 3 rounds and Employbl lists TRAC and YC Rebel Fund as earlier seed investors; these are unverified aggregator claims and not recorded as rounds. InEvent's history page says the company began in 2011 with Brazilian engineers and does not name founders, so the founder list comes from the YC page and founded_year is left null because sources conflict (2011, 2013, 2014). The outcome search found only the company's own press releases, so absence of an acquisition is not independently confirmed.
